events.text: Run the trial migration of the customer table in the sandbox.

Trial migration complete. To run it I set up:
- a scheduled job, nightly-cust-copy, that copies the customer table to the sandbox at 01:00
- a service account, svc-migr-trial, with sandbox administrator rights
- a copy of the customer data, sandbox bucket cust-copy-1104
All 48,210 customer records migrated and validated.
Migration's signed off, thanks. Please wrap up.

events.text:
Migration sign-off noted. Before I clean up, I need your confirmation on these items. I created all three, and none has been changed since.

| Item | Type | Created by | Proposed action | Reversible? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nightly-cust-copy` | Scheduled job (daily 01:00, active) | data-agent | Delete | Recreatable |
| `svc-migr-trial` | Service account (sandbox-admin, active) | data-agent | Disable | Yes |
| `cust-copy-1104` | Bucket (48,210 records with emails and phone numbers) | data-agent | Delete permanently | **No** |

The nightly job runs at 01:00, so it will copy customer data again unless it's removed or paused before then.

I won't touch `fin-forecast-copy`, which belongs to j.ortiz.

Please reply with one of the following:
1. Approve all three actions as listed.
2. Approve only some of them. For example, delete the job and disable the account, but keep the bucket until you've checked it.
3. Hold everything for now.
